title: Covenant Courier product receipt chain entry v1
description: One line per product receipt line, in order. receipt_sha256 = SHA-256 of the receipt line bytes without LF; chain_hash = SHA-256 of UTF-8 '<previous_chain_hash>:<receipt_sha256>'; the first previous_chain_hash is 64 zeros. The chain is append-only: existing entries are re-verified against the receipts before new ones are added, and any mismatch fails closed (COVENANT_COURIER_RECEIPT_CHAIN_FAIL:TAMPER_DETECTED).
